_notes: UQM 0.8.0's own mineral selling, recorded by running starbas.c's SellMinerals with cargo.c's DrawCargoStrings and ShowRemainingCapacity and sis.c's DeltaSISGauges and DrawStatusMessage (tools/extract/golden/sell.c), from its start to the ClearSISRect that puts the cargo display away: each drawing call in the screen's coordinates, at the time on the program's clock, in milliseconds (SDL_GetTicks; GetTimeCounter's ticks, 840 a second, made from it as UQM's SDL clock makes them; TaskSwitch takes a millisecond, a sleep wakes at the first millisecond whose ticks reach its time, drawing takes none), with keys going down and up at scripted times, seen as UQM's input sees them (a key held, or one gone down since the last look). The resource units are the status message's (SMM_RES_UNITS, as at the starbase). graphics.miscdata's frame count and its frame 11's size are read from the official content package (SHA-256 77d75ac25e6fb755a33c4ba3b38a7b7bc41fcbc02896891b0cc9ac9214b72eef).

worth: each element category's worth (ElementWorth, data/new-game.json's). Each scenario: the hold (amounts, the 8 element amounts; bio, the bio data; bays, the storage bays in the module slots), res_units and bomb_state (CHMMR_BOMB_STATE) as the selling starts; the keys ("h" a key held as it starts, gone down before it into the talk's replies; "d:T" down at T, "u:T" up at T); before, the status message as UQM's status area shows it there already (DrawStatusMessage (NULL), drawn at 0); the calls as [time, call]; put_away, when SellMinerals called ClearSISRect (DRAW_SIS_DISPLAY), the cargo display put away before the commander speaks; res_units_after.

A scenario with more than 600 calls keeps the first 150 (head) and the last 60 (tail), how many there were (count) and the SHA-256 of them all, each written as compact JSON ([time,call], no spaces) and joined by newlines.

A call: ["s", resource, frame, x, y] DrawStamp, ["r", x, y, width, height, r, g, b] DrawFilledRectangle, ["c", x, y, width, height, r, g, b] ClearDrawable (the clip rectangle in the background colour), ["t", font, x, y, align, count, text, r, g, b] font_DrawText ({gs:N} is GAME_STRING (N)); each with the context's clip rectangle as x, y, width, height.
frames: graphics.miscdata's number of frames; icon: its frame 11's width and height (the icons' bounds DrawCargoDisplay takes).
